name: Overcoming Insecurity
overview: Scripture reveals that overcoming insecurity is rooted in trusting the Lord as our Shepherd who provides for all our needs, removing anxiety about life’s necessities. Believers find freedom and peace through knowing the truth of Christ’s justification and abiding in Him, which assures answered prayers and the absence of condemnation. This confidence comes from faith in Jesus Christ, enabling us to live by the Spirit rather than by fear or fleshly concerns.
